qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Exceptional, decades-evolved lean credit culture and decentralized operational efficiency producing an elite cost-to-income ratio of ~25-26%, unmatched among European banks. Empirically proven by 5-year median ROIC of 18.6% and ROE >20% (21.0% in 2024, 22.4% in 2025), with virtually zero structural credit loss impairments across multi-decade business cycles.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 10, REJECT). Ringkjøbing Landbobank is an extraordinarily well-managed niche bank, but under the Mauboussin outside-view persistence framework, commercial deposit banking possesses a structural baseline CAP of 5-10 years due to commoditized capital and credit cycle mean reversion. As a DKK 41B market cap Danish regional lender, its addressable runway is bounded by the Danish economy; expanding beyond its core regional footprint risks diluting its unique credit discipline and sub-26% cost culture. Capped at 10 years, failing the 15-year hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: Historical GAAP ROIC was 12.2% in 2022, 19.7% in 2023, 21.6% in 2024, and 17.5% in 2025 (5-year median 18.6%). Net income compounded from DKK 1,495M (2022) to DKK 2,313M (2025) with Owner EPS growing from 53.4 to 92.86 DKK (20.3% CAGR). Cost/income ratio remained world-class at 25.7% (2024) and 26.4% (2025). However, total loan assets are concentrated in Jutland/Copenhagen niche private banking and renewable energy/wind financing, leaving long-term reinvestment runway constrained by domestic Danish credit demand.
